rationale: The ten new shifted conditions fail the declared advantage criterion, completing matched execution/presentation pairs for context at 256 episodes and 32768 labels, all three noncontext tiers at 16 episodes and 32768 labels, and artifact evidence at 256 episodes and 8192 labels. Admit the second registered fit for these ten first-fit counterparts to test whether the differences depend on the trained reader. The artifact-only execution condition at 16 episodes improves over frequencies and the legal template but misses the joint-neural criterion, while complete-record presentation has a small opposite-direction change relative to native. These heterogeneous comparisons motivate fit sensitivity without promoting them to primary success. Average fits within whole lineages; no additional independent-world claim, new settings, criterion, lineages or occupancy seeds. Remaining sparse and complete long-history first fits are already admitted.
